summary_md: Assumed: brokers pay per deal; the junior's time is the cost; lenders will accept a standard pack.
artifact_md:
## Who
A UK commercial finance broker with two to five staff, preparing a lending application at month-end.

## Problem in their words
"I spend most of Tuesday on statements for one client." (assumption: typical, from one broker)

## Why now
Open banking data is now available for most SME accounts (changed 2025).

## What they do today
Spreadsheets and a junior who keys the numbers in.

## Expected outcome
Statement analysis per application from ~6 hours to under 1 hour, read from broker timesheets by 2027-03. Baseline unknown.

questions.context: Who pays: the broker per deal, or the lender?
Is 6 hours per application measured or a guess?
